overall: MARGINAL overall, GOOD on the Coron side: light wind, dry
limiterDetail: The main limiter is current , in the south and west during the pickups. Wind is light: ECMWF 5.5–9.4 kt now (gusts 8–13), mostly under 10 kt through the day. Tonight it builds to 12–15 kt at Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot and Barangonan, while the Coron side stays at 3–4 kt. Rain is not a factor: dry, 24h totals 0.0–1.2 mm. The current is in its morning pickup now to about 9 AM , eases about 11 AM–3 PM , picks up again about 5–8 PM , and goes slack about 10 PM–3 AM.

The latest items (to Mon 26 Oct 5:26 AM PHT) are final general flood advisories for the Visayas regions, none covering Palawan.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since yesterday afternoon
items: No material change to supply: arrivals stay normal through Wednesday. The morning current pickup is under way, so the grounds read 4 GOOD / 6 MARGINAL / 5 POOR / 1 VERY POOR right now (was 6 / 6 / 4 / 0 at 2 PM yesterday). Coron, Ciron, Decabobo and Panlaitan are GOOD; Decabaitot is VERY POOR at 1.5 kt.

Better than expected this morning: the 9–14 kt wind and showers forecast for today did not hold. ECMWF now has 5.5–9.4 kt and practically dry (under 1.3 mm all day). Week shifts: Tue 27 is now dry and calm (5.0 kt, gusts 12; was 2.9 mm). Wed 28 now brings light rain (1.9 mm) with 10 kt, gusts 18. Thu 29 is still the hardest day and wetter (11 kt, gusts 19, 7.1 mm; was 3.0 mm). Sat 31 rain has eased to light (4.2 mm; was 13.4 mm). PAGASA has nothing for Palawan.

bestWindow.headline: About 11 AM–3 PM today, then tonight 10 PM–3 AM on the sheltered grounds
details: 11 AM–3 PM: the widest easy window, with Decabobo 0.1, Culion, Linapacan, Galoc, Maglalambay and Panlaitan 0.2–0.3, Coron 0.3, wind 3–9 kt, dry. Coron and Panlaitan are workable now as well.
10 PM–3 AM tonight: slack at Alava and Binudac (0.1), Coron, Galoc, Maglalambay, Decabobo, Culion and Panlaitan (0.1–0.2), wind 3–9 kt there.
Keep small boats off Decabaitot, Tara, Turda and Alava until about 10 AM and during the 5–8 PM peak, and off Nangalao, Cabunlawan and Barangonan overnight when the wind reaches 12–15 kt.
